name: dev-core
description: Codex-native development entrypoints and orchestration for decision grilling, evidence-backed planning, resumable execution, TDD, review, verification, continuous learning, issue-driven development, test design, CI/CD and release design, conventions-as-guardrails, and external design deliverables.

interface.shortDescription: TDD, verification, review, and architecture workflows.
interface.longDescription: Dev Core packages Codex-native skills for planning, TDD, debugging, review, and evidence-backed completion. Planned execution keeps tightly coupled work with the parent and delegates when independent progress or specialized evidence justifies it. Risk and project requirements determine independent review separately. A centralized role profile and capability-checked resolver preserve explicit model requests; bounded handoffs and a delegation ledger track ownership and evidence. Hooks surface project state and block selected destructive commands. Offline tests and native-agent evaluation guidance separate policy checks from observed behavior and comparative results.
defaultPrompt: Use $dev-task to draft a design and TDD plan.
Use $dev-grill to pressure-test a material decision before planning.
Use $dev-execute to implement this plan through review gates.
Use $dev-review to review this change with dev-core criteria.
